widgets_values:
A super photorealistic masterpiece, cinematic fantasy editorial photography in the style of high fashion. An epic, breathtaking aerial chase scene high above the clouds in the "golden hour". The close-up image shows a silver cruise missile hurtling through the sky directly at the camera. The rocket is a masterpiece of futuristic engineering - a sleek chrome and white carbon fiber body with glowing blue plasma engines at the back, emitting jets of bright blue flame. The design combines natural curves with sharp, aggressive lines and complex mechanical details. A little further away, behind the rocket, a beautiful girl with large elephant ears can be seen flying to intercept the rocket, reaching with one hand for the rocket. Her face is an emotional center: big eyes staring forward with intense determination, slightly parted lips reflecting bated breath, skin glowing with a hyperrealistic rush of adrenaline and divine light. Her long, flowing platinum-white hair flows behind her like liquid silk, reflecting the golden light of the sunset. She is wearing an incredibly elegant white couture combat dress, which is a mixture of angelic robes and high-fashion armor. The dress is made of thick flowing silk and delicate lace, which hugs the curves of her torso, becoming almost transparent.
The environment is a breathtaking sea of clouds at sunset of the golden hour — high cumulus clouds of golden, amber, pink and dark purple shades. Three-dimensional divine rays penetrate the clouds, creating spectacular pillars of warm light that illuminate the silver rocket and cast a shadow on the girl. The sky on the horizon changes from warm golden to dark blue above, creating a stunning gradient. Floating particles of clouds, mist and grains of divine light fill the air, creating an epic, otherworldly atmosphere. 8K resolution, ultra-detailed textures of feathers, fabric, chrome and cloud haze. Cinematic color rendition with warm golden highlights and cold blue shadows, absolute photorealism, a masterpiece of epic fantasy art.
